source_runtime.runtime_branch_head_subject: qa(core20k): establish fail-closed dual AI review pilot for 30 matched KUs
source_runtime.retrieval_method: git fetch from origin (https) + git show to local files; gzip decompressed locally. No GitHub push, no main modification, no Runtime/SRS/learning-record write.

status_definitions.EXACT_MATCH: Would require a Runtime field value identical to the legacy field value. Not used for any of the six, because Runtime has no sense_id or headword_id field to match exactly; claiming EXACT_MATCH for sense/headword identity would misrepresent the schema.
status_definitions.VERIFIED_HISTORICAL_MAPPING: KU identity verified exactly (verbatim ku_id in Runtime) and sense correspondence verified historically (shared w_ stem, kind=sense, gloss semantic equivalence). This is the strongest status the Runtime schema supports for these six.
status_definitions.CONFLICT: Runtime row contradicts the legacy record on rank, lemma, POS, kind, or sense (none found). Gloss wording variances itemised per record are not conflicts: they are paraphrase/order/abbreviation differences on the same sense.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Mapping cannot be proven from the Runtime row (none for these six; the prior 7bbd69b BLOCKED status was an evidence-availability blocker, now removed by reading the rows).

mapping_evidence.not_used_as_evidence: String similarity alone, Batch91 aggregate checks, and the prior BLOCKED gate's staging-only evidence were NOT used as mapping evidence. Only the direct Runtime row comparison above is used.
